hypotheses.title: Complete Certified Residual-Quotient SAT Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist constants b,k and a deterministic algorithm Q that, for every CNF F of length N, constructs in N^k time a complete rooted quotient DAG covering all partial assignments. Each merge has a polynomial-time certificate using variable renaming, invertible affine substitution, and fan-in-two definitions with at most b log N exposed variables; accepting sinks exist iff F is satisfiable, rejecting sinks cover all other paths, and witnesses are reconstructible in N^k time.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Traversing the polynomial quotient DAG would decide CNF-SAT in polynomial time and imply P = NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_ALGORITHM: repair H018 by requiring coverage, two-sided correctness, bounded total computation, and witness reconstruction.
hypotheses.next_gate: Define a concrete canonicalizer and either prove a polynomial state bound or find an explicit residual-diversity counterfamily.
falsification_conditions: An explicit CNF family forcing superpolynomial certified quotient states.
A concrete input on which Q violates coverage, soundness, completeness, certificate validity, or witness recovery.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: OPEN records only survival of the registered attacks. No truth, novelty, or probability claim is made.

hypotheses.title: Finite-Gate Proof-Carrying Variable-Elimination Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There is a finite Boolean gate set B, constants r,c,k, and a fixed scheduler that eliminates variables from every CNF using only B-interface DAG nodes of fan-in at most two, explicit node-count accounting, and constant-scope truth-table or polynomial certificates for exact existential equivalence. The run uses at most N^k nodes, exposes at most c log N boundary variables per interface, ends in the correct Boolean constant, and stores a polynomial witness trace.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would give a deterministic polynomial-time SAT algorithm and imply P = NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_ALGORITHM: formalize H019 so that no interface node can hide an unbounded semantic oracle.
hypotheses.next_gate: Build the smallest concrete template library and exhaustively search for counterexamples before attempting a universal node-bound proof.
falsification_conditions: An explicit family forcing superpolynomial interface nodes or omega(log N) boundaries for every allowed scheduler.
A local certificate failure or incorrect final constant for a concrete template set.

hypotheses.title: Affine-Cardinality Core Decomposition Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist constants c,k and a deterministic polynomial-time compiler that transforms every CNF F of length N, using only checkable XOR and cardinality definitions, into an equisatisfiable conjunction A and R where A is an explicit affine-plus-cardinality system solvable in polynomial time, the primal treewidth of R after substitution of all consequences of A is at most c log N, and assignments lift and project in polynomial time.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Polynomial-time solving of A combined with bounded-treewidth dynamic programming on R would decide SAT and imply P = NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_ALGORITHM: broaden H017 from parity-only extraction to a precisely certified affine-plus-cardinality core.
hypotheses.next_gate: Specify the exact cardinality solver interface and attack mixed random-expander formulas whose noncore residual remains wide.
falsification_conditions: An explicit family whose residual has omega(log N) treewidth under every allowed certified decomposition.
Superpolynomial blow-up or invalid witness projection on a concrete compiler.

hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Polynomial-time submodular minimization would decide SAT and imply P = NP.

falsification_conditions: A representation lower bound for an explicit CNF family against every finite local submodular gadget grammar.

hypotheses.title: Deterministic Isolation-to-Tractable-Residual Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There is a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm that, for every CNF F, outputs poly(|F|) polynomial-size hash constraints h_i such that F is satisfiable iff some F AND h_i has exactly one satisfying assignment, and every uniquely satisfiable residual produced by the construction belongs to a polynomial-time decidable certified class with witness recovery.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Testing all residuals would decide SAT deterministically in polynomial time and imply P = NP.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_ALGORITHM: combine deterministic isolation with an explicit tractable unique-residual theorem, avoiding the false claim that isolation alone solves SAT.
hypotheses.next_gate: Specify the certified residual class and prove closure of the isolation construction into that class.
falsification_conditions: A satisfiable formula for which no produced residual is uniquely satisfiable.
